posts.name: Gus_Smedstad
posts.cooked:
I secured the unlock last night with PW Haka (for rapid healing after Ra hits 1 HP), Wraith (for deck control), Argent Adept (to give Ra more turns and slow healing) and Grandpa Legacy (to give Ra more turns and for defense in general).

It went easily. Ra can both do damage and provide Flesh of the Sun God when he gets extra power uses. Osiris’s self-damage attacks don’t matter if everyone is using fire via Imbued FIre and immune to fire. The discards were more annoying, including Tefnut’s discards on her incapacitated side.

I left Shu for last. Normally I tend to target healers first, but Ra had little trouble doing enough damage to ignore the healing, and once Shu is the only one up he can only do damage via one shots, and the team has plenty of time to whittle Ra down to 1 HP.

I was worried that the turn Ra goes down to 1 HP was going to put him in danger of death, but all I had to do was put down a Ground Pound with Haka to neutralize any risk. Megacomputers had already mostly eliminated any threat of environment damage. I planned on protecting Ra from villain one shots with Lead from the Front, but I didn’t get that until I’d already brought Ra down to 1 and brought him immediately back up to 11 with Haka of Restoration.
